page_title: PAR 0-1 LAZ | Parma v Lazio 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Matteo Marchetti is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Here is a change. Danilo Cataldi is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Matias Vecino (Lazio).
86' Substitution. Milan Djuric (Parma) replaces Mandela Keita.
85' Parma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' It will be a corner kick for Parma.
82' 0 - 1 Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) gets one-on-one with the goalkeeper and takes an early shot which finds the back of the net.
77' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Matteo Marchetti's book.
77' That was really pointless! Toma Basic (Lazio) made a mindless challenge and the referee Matteo Marchetti showed him a red card.
77' Carlos Cuesta prepares a substitution. Adrian Benedyczak is replaced by Patrick Cutrone (Parma).
74' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
74' Parma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
70' It will be a substitution. Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) is ready to enter the pitch as Gaetano Oristanio walks off.
70' The manager makes a subsitution with Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) coming on for Patric.
70' Maurizio Sarri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) replacing Matteo Cancellieri.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) comes onto the pitch so that Taty Castellanos can be given a rest.
65' A mistake by a defender gifts Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
63' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
62' Great teamplay by Parma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
56' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) will deliver the corner kick.
56' The Parma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
53' Toma Basic (Lazio) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
52' Lazio control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
51' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marchetti had an easy-decision to make.
49' The Parma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' Carlos Cuesta makes a half-time substitution. Mariano Troilo comes on in place of Enrico Del Prato (Parma).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Mandela Keita (Parma) makes a strong challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ivan Provedel, who smothers the ball.
42' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes out his opponent after failing to control himself and the referee has no choice but to show him a deserved red card!
40' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Adam Marusic (Lazio).
38' Toma Basic (Lazio) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the right side of the goal, but Edoardo Corvi is equal to it and makes an easy save.
37' Dangerous play by Mandela Keita (Parma). Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
34' Good work from Lazio as they win a corner.
31' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
28' Toma Basic (Lazio) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
28' One of the Parma players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Lazio are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
27' Edoardo Corvi (Parma) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
26' It seemed like Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
24' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

21' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
17' Lazio quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
17' Adam Marusic (Lazio) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
15' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) commits a rough foul. Matteo Marchetti stops the game and makes a call.

13' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Ivan Provedel makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
12' Parma are ruled offside.
12' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked.
10' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ivan Provedel intercepts the ball.
10' Some patient build-up play from Parma as they look to unlock the defence.
7' Parma are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
3' Neat passing move from Lazio in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' A player from Lazio commits a rough challenge. Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
